name: Dental Floss Pick 50 Pcs Box - Dental Floss Toothpick Interdental Cleaner Toothpick Flosser
description:
Getwell RFL Dental Floss Pick 50pcs Box

Keep your teeth and gums healthy with Getwell Dental Floss Picks, designed for effective interdental cleaning. Each floss pick features a strong, friction-resistant nylon string and a convenient bendable tail that doubles as a toothpick, making oral hygiene simple and efficient.

Key Features:

Brand: Getwell (Sister concern of PRAN-RFL Group)

Quantity: 50 pieces per box

Color: Multicolor (randomly selected)

Durable Floss: Strong nylon string for effective cleaning

Dual Function: Bendable tail can be used as a toothpick

Ergonomic Design: Anti-skid handle for easy grip

Bow-Shaped Head: Conforms to oral cavity for cleaning between teeth efficiently

Easy to Use: Ideal for daily oral care and interdental cleaning

Maintain fresh breath and healthy gums effortlessly with Getwell RFL Dental Floss Picks.
